notes.title: Watch our Special Animated Intro for Murder by Numbers!
notes.content:
Hey everyone,

To celebrate Murder by Numbers getting a Steam release date of Friday March 6th we are delighted to share with you something we had specially created for the game - our extra special Murder by Numbers animated intro!

[previewyoutube=OoZNXhdjB6s;full]https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=OoZNXhdjB6s[/previewyoutube]
[h3]Credits[/h3]
[b]Studio Meala[/b]
Director: Sean Cunningham
Producer:  Stephen Fagan
Storyboard Artists: Sinead O'Regan, Rebecca Reynolds
Animation:  Hardik Manktala, Sean Cunningham, Sinead O'Regan
Background Artist:  Sinead O'Regan
Compositing and Effects Artist: Olga Selma Egan

[b]HONOR'S THEME - VOCAL VERSION[/b]
Lyrics - Ed Fear
Composition - Masakazi Sugimori
Performance - Bright Light Bright Light


Not long now until you can get your hands on the game, don't forget to add Murder by Numbers to your wishlist to get notified as soon as it goes on sale!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1140290/Murder_by_Numbers/
